source_clause: EDPR3.1) If any items listed above are selected while vehicle in motion, a bonk tone will be played along with the message “Function not available while vehicle in Motion.”
leaf_desc_037: EDPR3.1) If any items listed above are selected while vehicle in motion, a bonk tone will be played along with the message “Function not available while vehicle in Motion.”
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.3.1（EDPR3.1）—— 行車中選取受限項目時播放 bonk 音並顯示指定訊息。關鍵情境條件：受測動作為對已變灰項目之選取，屬不被允許之操作（§12 首匹配 → 負向測試）；受限項目之清單出自 9.3，故併列該節。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 之單位為「回饋」，項目是否變灰屬 9.3、進行中被中斷屬 9.3.2。

tcs.tc_title: Bonk tone and message when a restricted item is selected
tcs.test_item:
Bonk tone and message when a restricted item is selected
(Verifies that selecting a restricted item in motion plays a bonk tone and displays the specified message)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A Driver Profile is active and the “Edit Profile” tab is displayed
2. The vehicle is in motion on a test track
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the greyed-out “Delete Profile” item
2. Read the screen and check that the bonk tone and the message are presented
tcs.expected_result:
1. The selection is not accepted
2. A bonk tone is played and “Function not available while vehicle in Motion.” is displayed
tcs.priority_basis: 限制之回饋（音效與訊息）呈現
